name: tom
description: Tom close mic (rack or floor tom)
notes: Floor tom has lower fundamentals (70-90 Hz) than rack toms (120-200 Hz). Adjust the sustain boost frequency accordingly. Cut 400-600 Hz to remove cardboard/boxy tone. Boost 2-5 kHz for stick attack. This preset is a general starting point — the main differentiation between rack and floor is the sustain frequency.

filters._note: sustain body (adjust: rack 120-200 Hz, floor 70-90 Hz)
